subject.title: fix(workspace): prevent false Missing labels on existing files and fix panel layout overlap

question: Should sessions.files.list ever expose existence, size, and mtime for transcript-mentioned paths outside the workspace or rejected by fs-safe, or should those entries stay filtered/neutral behind the existing boundary?
rationale: That choice changes a Gateway operator-read file metadata boundary, so automation should not decide it by accepting raw fs.statSync behavior from a contributor PR.

options.title: Keep Metadata Behind Fs-Safe
options.body: Filter or neutralize external entries without raw filesystem metadata and add regression coverage for outside-root, symlink-rejected, and directory paths.

options.title: Split Layout From Backend Semantics
options.body: Land a refreshed CSS-only repair separately and leave external path semantics to the canonical workspace-panel issue.

options.title: Accept External Metadata Deliberately
options.body: Allow transcript-mentioned external metadata only with explicit maintainer/security approval, protocol/UI tests, and documented behavior.

recommendation.title: Keep Metadata Behind Fs-Safe
recommendation.body: Filter or neutralize external entries without raw filesystem metadata and add regression coverage for outside-root, symlink-rejected, and directory paths.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent work touched workspace file preview hardening and adjacent read-only browsing boundaries.
